statBlock.name: Firbolg Primeval Warden
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: Wardens of Hiatea teach children and tend the hearth. Those who patrol the borders hunt down dangers before they reach the community.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Spear or Fire Lance.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.
Fire Lance. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 13).
At will. Entangle, Speak with Animals, Speak with Plants.
1/day each. Commune with Nature (cast as an action), Detect Magic, Disguise Self.
sections.Bonus actions: Hidden Step (2/day). The warden becomes magically invisible until the start of its next turn. Making an attack roll or forcing a creature to make a saving throw ends the effect early.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 136.

statBlock.name: Firbolg Wanderer
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: Wanderers model themselves on Diancastra. They use disguises and misdirection to make their own names.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword, Bewitching Bolt, or both.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage in either case.
Bewitching Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be charmed until the start of its next turn.
Spellcasting. Cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 14).
At will. Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Tasha's Hideous Laughter.
1/day each. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Dispel Magic, Polymorph.
sections.Bonus actions: Duplicitous Movement (1/day). Create an illusory duplicate in a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft., then optionally swap places with it. The duplicate vanishes after 1 minute, if the wanderer is incapacitated, or if it is more than 120 ft. from the wanderer. On later turns the wanderer can move the existing illusion up to 30 ft. as a bonus action, then optionally swap places with it.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 137.

statBlock.name: Fire Giant Forgecaller
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: A forgecaller tends forges and defends its community, often in Surtur’s name. Its armor contains enough heat to propel it through the air.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a saving throw, the giant can choose to succeed.
Fire Rune. The giant can use Magma Wave and Furnace Armor while it holds or wears the inscribed object. The object has AC 15, 40 HP, and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. It recovers all HP at the end of every turn. It crumbles if it reaches 0 HP or the giant dies. After the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a new one on an object it possesses when it finishes a short or long rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Forge Hammer attacks or two Heated Rock attacks.
Forge Hammer. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (5d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the giant can heat metal objects in a 30-ft.-radius sphere centered on the target until the start of the giant’s next turn. A creature touching heated metal at the start of its turn makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. Fire immunity prevents this disadvantage. The hammer can produce the heat burst once per turn.
Heated Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) fire damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or fall prone. After each throw, roll 1d6. On a 1–3 the giant runs out of rocks.
Magma Wave (requires Fire Rune). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure it takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and is restrained by rock. On a success it takes half damage. A creature can use an action to make a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself or a creature within its reach. Each mass of restraining rock has AC 17, 20 HP, and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Furnace Armor (requires Fire Rune). Smoke and cinders fill a 30-ft.-radius sphere centered on the giant and grant it half cover. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until the giant dies, the rune is destroyed, or the giant dismisses it with a bonus action.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 138.

statBlock.name: Fire Giant of Evil Fire
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: Devotion to Imix gives this giant the power to brand its enemies. Its armor fuses to its body when donned and bursts apart when it dies.

sections.Traits: Shrapnel Explosion. At 0 HP the giant’s armor explodes and destroys its body. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Searing Scepter attacks or two Bolt of Imix attacks.
Searing Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage and leaves a magical brand. The target becomes visible if invisible, cannot become invisible, and sheds dim light in a 5-ft. radius. The brand lasts 24 hours or until a spell that ends curses removes it from the creature or object.
Bolt of Imix. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) fire damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 139.

statBlock.name: Fire Hellion
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: A fire giant’s pact can turn it into a horned infernal smith. The weapons it forges send the souls of its kills to Avernus.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The hellion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Taker. A Giant or Humanoid the hellion reduces to 0 HP dies. Its soul rises as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours unless the creature is revived first. Once it rises, restoring the creature requires Wish or killing the lemure and casting True Resurrection on the original body.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage. A creature hit cannot regain HP until the start of the hellion’s next turn.
Infernal Orb. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. The magical orb bursts in a 20-ft.-radius sphere that spreads around corners. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 140.

statBlock.name: Firegaunt
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: A fire giant can rise as a firegaunt when hatred keeps it from passing on. Crimson fire runs through the corpse as it hunts the living.

sections.Traits: Fire Blood. A creature within 5 ft. that hits the firegaunt with a melee attack dealing piercing or slashing damage takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Heated Maul attacks.
Heated Maul. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Once per turn the firegaunt can make the maul erupt during this attack. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take another 10 (3d6) fire damage and 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
Crimson Rays (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. It catches fire either way. While burning, it cannot regain HP and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. It or another creature within reach can use an action to put out the fire.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 137.

statBlock.name: Flesh Colossus
statBlock.publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
statBlock.description: An adamantine skeleton supports the bodies of fallen giants. An elemental core inside the chest powers the construct and keeps it under control.

sections.Damage immunities: lightning, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Berserk. Destroying the core makes the colossus berserk until it is destroyed. On each of its turns it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is close enough to reach and attack, it attacks an object.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Magic Resistance. The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Siege Monster. The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Roll with advantage while berserk. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is pulled up to 15 ft. toward the colossus and becomes grappled (escape DC 17). It is restrained until this grapple ends. The colossus can hold up to two creatures this way.
Elemental Breath (Recharge 5–6). Choose acid, cold, fire, or lightning. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) damage of the chosen type on a failure or half as much on a success. When it exhales, creatures inside its chest cavity also take 40 (9d8) force damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature grappled by the colossus. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and swallows the creature. The chest cavity can hold up to two swallowed creatures. A swallowed creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the colossus, and takes 10 (3d6) force damage at the start of each of the colossus’s turns.
sections.Elemental core: The core is a Large object within the chest cavity with AC 16, 140 HP, and immunity to lightning, poison, and psychic damage. It sheds dim light in a 10-ft. radius. Destroying it makes the colossus berserk and prevents further swallowing. The colossus ejects all swallowed creatures, which land prone in spaces within 10 ft. If the colossus dies, swallowed creatures lose the restrained condition and can spend 10 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting prone.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 141.
